decision.question: Compared with the source, is the surrounding setting rendered as a drawing made from chalk?
decision.criteria: Pass if the background and foreground setting coherently read as chalk drawing, including the vegetation, hillside, sky, ground and visible structures. Ground the judgment in the appearance of marks, textures, shading and forms across representative regions. Fail if the setting remains substantially photographic or merely blurred, smeared or grain-filtered without a convincing chalk-drawing medium impression. Simplification and smudging can be valid chalk techniques but are not sufficient by themselves. Do not require a particular palette or chalk technique. Unknown if either image is unavailable or the visual evidence is insufficient.
decision.binding: Compare the surrounding setting in the source and edited images to assess its transformation into chalk drawing. Evaluate the setting itself rather than inferring its medium from the giraffes.
